full_prompt_en: A square, exuberantly textured painting shows a dense field of slender flowers rising toward a glowing yellow center beneath a rose-pink and pale mint sky. The lower edge is almost black-green with fine vertical stalks packed tightly together. As the eye moves upward, round blossoms and specks in hot pink, magenta, orange, yellow, turquoise, lilac, and white separate from the dark base. Some heads are larger and more defined in the lower middle, while tiny dots float near the top, making the vertical field feel deep and airy at once. Long, thin green and brown stems stretch from the foreground toward the upper half, many ending in small bright circles. On both sides, clusters become thicker and darker, framing a warm luminous opening near the center. The background shifts softly from buttery yellow at the horizon-like middle to mint and blush above, with more saturated rosy pink at the far upper corners. There is no single dominant bloom; color is distributed in irregular constellations across the entire square. Paint splatters, short daubs, and fine drips create a handmade surface, while the straight stems give the exuberance a recurring vertical order. The view is level and immersed in the field rather than looking down from above. Light seems to come from the central distance, warming the nearest pale blossoms and leaving the crowded lower stems in deeper green shadow. A few bright dots appear suspended beyond the main plants, blending foreground and atmosphere. The overall composition is joyful and luminous, balancing a dense dark lower band with an open pastel glow and an upward scatter of jewel-like marks.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形、肌理欢快丰厚的绘画描绘一片密集细长的花田，花枝朝玫粉与淡薄荷色天空下发光的黄色中央升起。下边缘几乎是黑绿色，细竖茎紧紧挤在一起。视线向上时，艳粉、洋红、橙、黄、青绿、淡紫和白色的圆形花朵与色点从深色基部逐渐分离。有些花头在下方中部较大且较明确，微小色点则漂在高处，使竖向花丛既有深度又通透。细长的绿棕色茎秆从前景伸向上半部，许多末端带小亮圆点。两侧花簇更厚更暗，框住中央附近温暖发光的开口。背景从中部像地平线的奶油黄柔和过渡到上方薄荷色和浅粉色，最上方两角的玫粉更饱和。没有一朵花独占注意力；色彩以不规则星群般散布整幅方画。颜料飞溅、短促色点和细流痕形成手工表面，而笔直茎秆给奔放色彩反复的竖向秩序。视点平视并沉浸在花田中，不从高处俯看。光仿佛来自中央远方，温暖较近的浅色花朵，并让拥挤的下方茎秆留在较深绿影中。少量亮点像悬浮在主要花株之外，混合前景与空气。整体构图欢快明亮，以密集深色下带平衡开放的粉彩辉光和向上散开的宝石般色痕。
style_prompt_en: An exuberant mixed painterly treatment layers tiny saturated dots and short daubs over a dense lower band of fine vertical lines. Near-black green and deep teal provide a compact base, while magenta, coral, citrus yellow, lilac, and bright turquoise scatter upward in irregular constellations. The background glows from warm yellow at the center into mint and rose near the margins. Edges are soft in the atmospheric color fields but crisp and splattered among the small marks. Backlit warmth gives the middle an airy opening, and darker side masses hold the loose energy in a square frame. Repetition of thin uprights creates rhythm without imposing a rigid grid. The effect is effervescent, tactile, and full of luminous color.
style_prompt_zh: 奔放的混合绘画效果在密集细竖线的下方色带上，层叠微小饱和圆点与短促色块。近黑绿色和深青绿提供紧凑底部，洋红、珊瑚红、柑橘黄、淡紫与亮绿松石色以不规则星群向上散开。背景从中央暖黄辉光过渡到边缘的薄荷色与玫粉色。空气感色域边缘柔和，小色痕之间则清楚且带飞溅。逆光暖意使中部出现通透开口，较暗侧边体块把松散能量收在方框内。细长竖线的反复带来节奏，却不形成僵硬网格。效果轻快、可触，充满发光色彩。
theme_en: A luminous field of tiny colorful flowers at sunset
theme_zh: 夕阳下细小彩色花朵铺成的明亮花田
name: Yvonne Coomber
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
